issues.description: Missing shebang '#!/usr/bin/env python3'. CS-1 requires both shebang and docstring. The docstring was fixed (now includes build system 'Makefile'), but the shebang line is still absent.
issues.recommendation: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' as the first line of conanfile.py for full CS-1 compliance. Non-blocking — does not affect recipe functionality.

summary: W4 Pre-PR Audit (Round 2) for kissfft 131.2.0 — PASS. All 5 previously identified issues have been correctly fixed: (1) R39 — conandata.yml now has single official GitHub URL with no mirror prefixes; (2) R33 — conanfile.py now has generators='VirtualBuildEnv' for proper toolchain setup; (3) P2 CS-5 — url field now contains actual URL 'https://cnb.cool/ohpcd/conan-recipes' instead of empty string; (4) P3 CS-1 — docstring now includes build system '(Makefile)'; (5) P3 CS-16 — unused 'import os' removed. P0 deception detection: all clear — test.c calls real kissfft API (kiss_fft_alloc, kiss_fft, kiss_fft_free) with forward+inverse FFT and reconstruction verification (R34 pass); no skipped tests (R9 pass); sha256 is valid 64-hex-char hash (not fake); status 'published' is consistent with conan-verify-report G2 PASS and test-report SUCCESS; no pre-compiled binaries in PR (R19 pass); no #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs (R8 pass); kissfft is pure math library, no deep adaptation needed (R40 pass). P1 recipe correctness: all clear — no hardcoded paths (uses self.source_folder/self.package_folder); platform compatibility OK (no Linux-only checks, make is platform-agnostic, CMakeLists uses if(UNIX)); R33 env var dependency resolved; R39 official GitHub URL; R37 first adaptation version; R26 not a system-named library; R38 library type, no commands.json needed; Conan 2.x API correct. One minor non-blocking P3 CS-1 issue: shebang line still missing from conanfile.py (docstring fix was done, shebang was not). Overall verdict: PASS — no P0 or P1 issues, all previous fixes verified correct, recipe is ready for PR.

R39_mirror_urls.details: conandata.yml has single official GitHub URL: https://github.com/mborgerding/kissfft/archive/refs/tags/131.2.0.tar.gz — no mirror URL prefixes.

R33_virtual_build_env.details: conanfile.py has 'generators = "VirtualBuildEnv"' class attribute for proper build environment setup from Conan profile.

P2_CS5_empty_url.details: conanfile.py url field is 'https://cnb.cool/ohpcd/conan-recipes' — actual URL, not empty string.

P3_CS1_docstring_build_system.details: conanfile.py docstring is '"""Conan recipe — kissfft 131.2.0 (Makefile)"""' — includes build system 'Makefile'.

P3_CS16_unused_import_os.details: conanfile.py imports are: from conan import ConanFile, from conan.tools.files import get/apply_conandata_patches/export_conandata_patches, from conan.tools.layout import basic_layout — no 'import os'.

p1_checks.R6_generated_files: PASS — no config.h, configure, Makefile.in, or CMakeCache.txt modifications.
p1_checks.R38_commands_json: PASS — kissfft is library type with KISSFFT_TOOLS=0, no commands.json needed.

p1_checks.hardcoded_paths: PASS — build uses cwd=self.source_folder, package uses PREFIX={self.package_folder}, both Conan variables.
